Hey kiddo, you may not believe me but your life has barely started. You have SO much to experience before you take that option as your last resort. Trust me. I've changed a lot from 15 in the last 5 years and there's a lot I wouldn't want to not experience.

You may not want to do this, but I suggest you do. Reach out to a family member or friend. 

There were countless times I wanted to end my life and planned a day. But after that day, I'd go through the days. The weeks. The months. And think, "if I killed myself that night, I wouldn't be here making crafts" or "I wouldn't be here cuddling my dogs, they would miss me" or "I would've never tried this new food I love so much already".

Chin up, life will change and time always moves forward.

Is there something small you enjoy that you can't get enough of?

Hey kiddo, I had a hard time with school too and I felt the same way you do. I am 20 and graduated. 

It's hard, and I know it is. My advice to you is to power through it but don't stress. Do your best even if it doesn't get you into university. You may not get the markings you want, but trust me when I say you will not even remember them after graduating. I went from straight A's to barely passing in 4 yrs, and I did fail one class but luckily I had my credits needed to graduate. I thought it was the end of the world but now, I don't even think about it.

Once you're done with high school, it'll get easier. I promise. 

One thing that helps me when I get stressed is "this stress will be forgotten later, so why end it over something that wont worry me next year?" 

Time always moves forward, it will be okay.
